name: Leather Wireless Charging Pad
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from premium faux leather with a smooth and elegant surface.
    - Built-in wireless charging module for convenient cable-free charging.
    - Durable construction designed for everyday use at home, in the office, or while traveling.
    - Available in five colors: Brown, Black, White, Grey, and Red.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Pad Size: 10.2" × 7.5" (25.91 × 19.05 cm)
    - Slim, lightweight design that fits easily on desks, nightstands, and workstations.
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and exceptional detail.
    - Single-sided printing on the front surface.
    - Produces sharp, high-resolution images with excellent color accuracy.
    - Suitable for custom photos, artwork, logos, names, and personalized designs.
    - Durable print quality with long-lasting color retention under normal use.

 

  • Care Instructions:
    - Wipe the surface gently with a soft, dry, or slightly damp cloth.
    - Avoid excessive moisture, soaking, or direct exposure to liquids.
    - Do not use abrasive cleaners, solvents, or harsh chemicals.
    - Keep away from extreme heat and direct sunlight for extended periods.
    - Disconnect the power source before cleaning.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Provides convenient wireless charging for Qi-enabled smartphones and compatible devices.
    - Functions as a stylish desk accessory while keeping devices charged and easily accessible.
    - Ideal for offices, home workspaces, bedside tables, study areas, and business environments.
    - Combines personalized decoration with everyday functionality.
    - Includes a USB-C charging port and USB-C cable for reliable power connection.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - This personalized Leather Wireless Charging Pad makes a practical and thoughtful gift for family members, friends, coworkers, teachers, students, and professionals. 
    - Perfect for birthdays, Christmas, Father's Day, Mother's Day, graduations, anniversaries, housewarming celebrations, employee appreciation events, and many other special occasions. 
    - Combining modern technology with personalized design, it is a meaningful gift that is both useful and memorable.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3–5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7–15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 × Leather Wireless Charging Pad

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
